1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<script>
const canvas=document.querySelector('#scene'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),ui={overlay:$('#overlay'),hud:$('#hud'),health:$('#health'),meter:$('#meter'),score:$('#score'),style:$('#style'),styleLetter:$('#styleLetter'),styleLabel:$('#styleLabel'),combo:$('#combo'),wave:$('#wave'),bossbar:$('#bossbar'),bossHealth:$('#bossHealth'),result:$('#result'),resultText:$('#resultText')};
let W=0,H=0,dpr=1,last=0,active=false,gameOver=false,time=0,shake=0,score=0,keys={},mouse={x:0,y:0};
function resize(){dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;canvas.width=W*dpr;canvas.height=H*dpr;ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
const world={floor:0,depth:0};
const player={x:0,y:0,z:0,vz:0,hp:100,max:100,face:1,attack:0,attackType:0,combo:0,lastHit:0,inv:0,dodge:0,shootCd:0,fire:0,jump:0,lock:false,stun:0,walk:0};
let enemies=[],particles=[],bolts=[],slashes=[],floaters=[],wave=1,kills=0,waveWait=0,stylePoints=0,styleRank=0,comboTimer=0,hitCount=0;
const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function groundY(){return H*.76}function sx(x){return W*.5+(x-player.x)*Math.min(W/1000,1.15)}function sy(y,z=0){return groundY()-y*1.1-z}
function startGame(){active=true;gameOver=false;score=0;kills=0;wave=1;waveWait=0;stylePoints=0;styleRank=0;comboTimer=0;hitCount=0;enemies=[];particles=[];bolts=[];slashes=[];floaters=[];Object.assign(player,{x:0,y:0,z:0,vz:0,hp:100,face:1,attack:0,combo:0,lastHit:0,inv:0,dodge:0,shootCd:0,fire:0,lock:false,stun:0,walk:0});spawnWave();ui.overlay.classList.add('hide');ui.hud.style.display='block';ui.bossbar.style.display='none';ui.result.style.display='none';}
$('#start').onclick=startGame;$('#again').onclick=startGame;
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{let k=e.key.toLowerCase();keys[k]=true;if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();if(!active)return;if(k==='j')attack(1);if(k==='k')shoot();if(k==='l')dodge();if(k===' '&&!player.z&&!player.vz)player.vz=12;if(k==='shift')player.lock=!player.lock;});
addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false);
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{mouse.x=e.clientX;mouse.y=e.clientY});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!active)return;if(e.button===0)attack(1);if(e.button===2)shoot()});canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
document.querySelectorAll('.touch-btn').forEach(b=>{const k=b.dataset.key;b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();keys[k]=true;if(k==='j')attack(1);if(k==='k')shoot();if(k==='l')dodge()});['pointerup','pointercancel','pointerleave'].forEach(ev=>b.addEventListener(ev,e=>{keys[k]=false}))});
function spawnWave(){let boss=wave%4===0;let count=boss?1:Math.min(2+wave,7);for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let x=player.x+rand(390,640)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1);enemies.push({x,y:rand(-60,60),hp:boss?180:45+wave*6,max:boss?180:45+wave*6,kind:boss?'boss':Math.random()<.25?'stalker':'grin',face:-Math.sign(x-player.x),speed:boss?45:rand(65,92),attackCd:rand(.8,2),attack:0,hit:0,stun:0,dead:0,phase:rand(0,5),id:Math.random()})}ui.wave.textContent=`SECTOR ${String(wave).padStart(2,'0')} · ${boss?'EL CARCELERO':'LA GRIETA'}`;if(boss)ui.bossbar.style.display='block';else ui.bossbar.style.display='none';}
function particle(x,y,z,color,n=8,power=150){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let a=rand(0,Math.PI*2),v=rand(power*.25,power);particles.push({x,y,z,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,vz:rand(10,power*.55),life:rand(.24,.65),max:.65,size:rand(1.5,4),color})}}
function floatText(x,y,text,color='#f3d9aa'){floaters.push({x,y,text,color,life:.85})}
function addStyle(n){stylePoints=Math.max(0,stylePoints+n);comboTimer=4.2;hitCount++;let r=stylePoints>=900?'S':stylePoints>=550?'A':stylePoints>=300?'B':stylePoints>=130?'C':stylePoints>0?'D':0;if(r!==styleRank){styleRank=r;ui.styleLetter.textContent=r||'D';ui.styleLabel.textContent=(r||'D')+' · '+({S:'SENSACIONAL',A:'ATREVIDO',B:'BRUTAL',C:'CAÓTICO',D:'DESPIADADO'}[r||'D']);}ui.style.classList.add('show');ui.combo.textContent=hitCount+' GOLPE'+(hitCount===1?'':'S');ui.combo.classList.add('show');}
function attack(heavy=1){if(!active||gameOver||player.attack>0||player.stun>0)return;player.attack=heavy?.34:.27;player.attackType=heavy;player.combo=(player.combo%3)+1;player.lastHit=0;let range=player.combo===3?155:118;slashes.push({x:player.x+player.face*42,y:player.y,life:.25,max:.25,face:player.face,type:player.combo});particle(player.x+player.face*40,player.y,45,'#ffd989',4,80)}
function shoot(){if(!active||player.shootCd>0)return;player.shootCd=.24;player.fire=.12;let target=nearestTarget();let tx=target?target.x:player.x+player.face*700,ty=target?target.y:0,dx=tx-player.x,dy=ty-player.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;bolts.push({x:player.x+player.face*30,y:player.y+16,z:55,vx:dx/d*570,vy:dy/d*570,life:1.6});particle(player.x+player.face*26,player.y,55,'#8ceaff',5,80)}
function dodge(){if(!active||player.dodge>0||player.inv>0)return;player.dodge=.32;player.inv=.52;player.x+=player.face*40;particle(player.x,player.y,12,'#8b9cff',9,120)}
function nearestTarget(){return enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead).sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.x-player.x)-Math.abs(b.x-player.x))[0]}

content.text:
He creado **UMBRA: Juicio de ceniza**, un hack and slash jugable en `index.html`, sin dependencias externas.

Incluye combos de espada, disparos arcanos, esquiva con invulnerabilidad, salto, fijado de objetivo, enemigos con patrones de ataque, oleadas y un jefe final en el sector 4. También cuenta con puntuación, rango de estilo, recuperación de vida y controles táctiles para móvil.

**Controles:** WASD o flechas para moverte, J para atacar, K para disparar, L para esquivar, Espacio para saltar y Shift para fijar el objetivo. En escritorio también puedes atacar con clic izquierdo y disparar con clic derecho.

Verifiqué la sintaxis de JavaScript. No pude hacer una captura del juego porque Chromium no está instalado en este entorno.
